svg.title: A 3 by 3 filter laid on every 3 by 3 window of a 6 by 6 image of a 7: at each window the nine products add up to one number of the output
svg.text: pixel x weight, under the window
the same 9 weights at all 16 windows

g.title: Window at row 0, column 0: the nine products add up to 0, output (0, 0)
Window at row 0, column 1: the nine products add up to -2, output (0, 1)
Window at row 0, column 2: the nine products add up to -3, output (0, 2)
Window at row 0, column 3: the nine products add up to 0, output (0, 3)
Window at row 1, column 0: the nine products add up to 0, output (1, 0)
Window at row 1, column 1: the nine products add up to -2, output (1, 1)
Window at row 1, column 2: the nine products add up to 1, output (1, 2)
Window at row 1, column 3: the nine products add up to -1, output (1, 3)
Window at row 2, column 0: the nine products add up to -1, output (2, 0)
Window at row 2, column 1: the nine products add up to -1, output (2, 1)
Window at row 2, column 2: the nine products add up to 1, output (2, 2)
Window at row 2, column 3: the nine products add up to -2, output (2, 3)
Window at row 3, column 0: the nine products add up to -2, output (3, 0)
Window at row 3, column 1: the products add up to 3, the most there is: the stroke the filter looks for is exactly here
Window at row 3, column 2: the nine products add up to -2, output (3, 2)
The last window: -1. The output is a picture again, a feature map: 3 where the 7 has the filter's stroke, lower everywhere else, from the same 9 weights at every window
